texts: bad: "dim" is dropped, so the question asks about any lanterns of the Hollows rather than the dim ones — and it cannot be put back, because a describing word on a definite plural ("the dim lanterns") is recorded of the individual lanterns, never of the set, so a question aimed at the set has nothing to bind. Ask about a single lantern, where the property sits on the thing itself: "Why do surviving nightmoths flee to a dim lantern of the Hollows during a sky-cat hunt?"
